fed_effective_rate.source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York EFFR Markets Data API

ecb_deposit_rate.source: European Central Bank Data Portal deposit facility rate

us_ig_market_credit_stress_proxy.source: Yahoo adjusted-close market proxy: LQD relative to IEF (20d relative underperformance)

us_hy_market_credit_stress_proxy.source: Yahoo adjusted-close market proxy: HYG relative to IEI (20d relative underperformance)

breakeven_inflation.semantics: nominal Treasury yield minus matched-maturity real Treasury yield; market-implied inflation compensation proxy, not a point forecast

term_premium.semantics: estimated compensation for duration risk; model output, not directly observable

policy_expectations_proxy.semantics: front-end sovereign yield versus current policy rate is a policy-path proxy, not meeting-by-meeting futures pricing
policy_expectations_proxy.provider_note: Fed policy level comes directly from the New York Fed EFFR publication; ECB policy level comes directly from the ECB Data Portal.

credit_stress.semantics: normalized market-based credit-stress diagnostic: IG uses LQD versus IEF and HY uses HYG versus IEI; higher relative underperformance means more stress. This is not an option-adjusted spread and no proprietary OAS is redistributed.

yield_decomposition.reading: Use real-yield, inflation-compensation and ACM term-premium moves jointly; they are overlapping diagnostics and should not be arithmetically double-counted as independent causes.

equity_interpretation.higher_real_yields: typically restrictive for long-duration growth, housing and other rate-sensitive assets if sustained
equity_interpretation.higher_breakevens: points toward greater inflation compensation and may favor nominal-growth/inflation-sensitive exposures relative to long-duration assets, conditional on growth
equity_interpretation.higher_term_premium: raises long-end discount rates independently of a simple Fed-path story and can pressure equity multiples and long-duration financing
equity_interpretation.wider_credit: signals tighter private-sector financial conditions and higher downside risk for leveraged/cyclical issuers
equity_interpretation.policy_proxy: front-end gaps suggest easing/tightening bias but are not a substitute for OIS or futures meeting probabilities
